name: ABCcount public benchmark
description: A pre-registered, blind comparison of how often AI writing tools change the meaning of a document when asked to rewrite it: figures, hedges, negations and technical terms. 300 documents in three sets (100 open-access research abstracts, 100 business emails, 100 oil-and-gas field notes) are rewritten by ABCcount, the same models without ABCcount, Grammarly and QuillBot. Two independent annotators score every rewrite without knowing which tool produced it. The documents, all outputs, all scores and the analysis scripts will be published, whatever the result.
